name: The Bad Art Dimension
source:
Welcome to the Bad Art Dimension!
Somehow, you are now on a dimension with bad art and you are transforming into a stickman, but don't worry, Tin and Chachi will help you!

[From [url=https://bluestarr-games.itch.io/the-bad-art-dimension]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
歡迎來到畫渣次元！
不知為何，你來到了一個畫工糟糕的次元，還正逐漸變成火柴人。不過別擔心，Tin和Chachi會幫助你！

[摘自[url=https://bluestarr-games.itch.io/the-bad-art-dimension]Itch.io[/url]]
